Plant-based restaurant chain Greenr has expanded its footprint in Mumbai with the launch of its 12th outlet in India at Cafés. Restaurants. Bars., International Business Park, Oberoi Garden City, Goregaon. ***The new outlet brings Greenr’s plant-based dining concept, specialty coffee offerings, and community-driven experiences to one of Mumbai’s growing commercial hubs.***

***Designed to cater to a range of consumer needs, the space will serve customers looking for dining options, coffee meetings, flexible work sessions, and social gatherings.*** Known for its vegetarian menu and specialty coffee, Greenr offers globally inspired cuisine alongside wellness and cultural experiences. The Goregaon outlet will also host events focused on wellness, creativity, culture, and community engagement.

> Vaibhav Nagori, COO, Greenr said, “***As India’s first plant-forward restaurant chain, Greenr remains committed to its path of spreading a plant-based and community-focused lifestyle across the country. The opening of our 12th outlet is an important milestone in that journey, reflecting both our near-term and long-term vision for expansion. Every Greenr space is more than a restaurant, it is a place where people come together over conscious food, meaningful conversations, and shared experiences. Our new home in Goregaon is another step towards building communities that embrace mindful living, and we're excited to welcome many more people into the Greenr family.***”

***The outlet is expected to serve professionals, corporate employees, residents, and visitors within the Oberoi Garden City ecosystem.*** It combines a café format with a contemporary dining experience while maintaining the brand’s focus on food, wellness, and community engagement.

> Kshitij Bahri, Senior General Manager - Commercial Leasing, Oberoi Realty said, “***At Oberoi Realty, we believe that the quality of a workplace extends well beyond the four walls of an office. It is shaped by the environment around it; the places people can meet, dine, unwind and connect. This has been integral to our vision for International Business Park and its evolution into a destination that brings together business, hospitality, dining and other lifestyle experiences. The addition of Greenr further strengthens this proposition. ***Earlier, Swiggy had appointed separate finance leadership roles for its Food Marketplace and Instamart businesses, highlighting the company's efforts to build dedicated management structures for its core verticals.*** The leadership expansion aligns with Swiggy's long-term growth plans, particularly for Instamart. ***Swiggy's quick commerce business has been a major focus area, with Instamart reporting strong growth in order volumes and gross order value.*** The company continues to invest in technology, logistics infrastructure, dark store expansion, and category diversification to strengthen its position in the market. Aspri Spirits has acquired global ownership of U’Luvka Vodka, strengthening its portfolio of premium and super-premium alcoholic beverage brands. The deal marks a strategic move by the Indian alco-beverage company as it continues to build a portfolio of owned international spirits brands. ***With the acquisition, U’Luvka Vodka joins Aspri Spirits’ existing portfolio, which includes Dos Flamos Tequila, A.Baronet Brandy, and wine labels such as Born West, Bush Ballad, Golden Sparrow, Monte Pacifico, and What The Fox.***

***U’Luvka, a Polish vodka brand with a presence in 30 countries, is known for its focus on traditional Polish production methods.*** The vodka is made using Polish rye and grains combined with aquifer water and undergoes a distillation and filtration process. The brand's tasting profile includes creamy notes, subtle sweetness, grain spice, floral and vanilla aromas, and a woody finish. The acquisition is expected to support U’Luvka's expansion through Aspri Spirits' existing distribution network and relationships across both on-trade and off-trade channels. The company plans to leverage its market presence to strengthen the brand's reach in international markets.

We are excited to steward its next phase of growth, expand its presence across global markets and preserve the heritage that has made it one of the most distinctive vodkas in the premium category.***"

U’Luvka recently received a Gold Medal at the London Spirits Competition 2026, where products are assessed based on quality, value, and packaging. ***According to Aspri Spirits, the company will focus on expanding the vodka brand into new international markets while continuing investments in brand development, product quality, and innovation.***

The acquisition reflects a broader shift in strategy for Aspri Spirits as it increases ownership of premium international spirits brands alongside its established distribution business. The move is expected to strengthen the company's position in the global premium spirits, luxury beverage, and alco-beverage markets.

![Hiranandani Teams Up with Fern and Marriott in Alibaug](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-08/keindenw.jpg)

Hiranandani Communities has partnered with The Fern Hotels and Resorts, under the Series by Marriott collaboration, to introduce branded serviced apartments at Hiranandani Sands, its integrated coastal township in Nagaon, Alibaug. ***The collaboration brings together Hiranandani Communities, The Fern Hotels and Resorts and Marriott International to offer professionally managed serviced residences within a township development.*** The project reflects the growing demand for hospitality-led residential real estate, branded residences and managed vacation homes in India.

The development is designed to combine residential ownership with hospitality services, offering homeowners access to professionally managed accommodation. The serviced apartments will operate under a "***lock-and-leave***" model, allowing owners to rent out their units through the management company when the residences are not being used personally, subject to applicable management and operating terms.

***Industry experts have noted increasing demand for branded residences and managed real estate assets as buyers seek properties that combine ownership with hospitality services, rental opportunities and long-term asset management.***

> Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani, Chairman, Hiranandani Communities said, “***India's homebuyer has evolved. They are no longer just purchasing four walls, they are investing in a way of living, a standard of service, and a lifestyle experience. This collaboration with The Fern Hotels and Resorts and Marriott brings exactly that to Alibaug, globally benchmarked hospitality, integrated seamlessly into a home you own. We've always believed real estate should serve the life being lived within it, not just the structure itself. Alibaug is already an established tourism and hospitality destination; with improving connectivity and infrastructure, it is now evolving into a year-round lifestyle and real estate destination, creating a natural bridge between leisure, hospitality and long-term living. This partnership is our commitment to being part of that evolution – for our residents, for guests, and for the local community that will grow alongside it.***”

***Kiran Andicot, Senior Vice President, South Asia, Marriott International, also participated virtually during the announcement, representing Marriott International in the collaboration.*** The hospitality-led residential project at Hiranandani Sands aims to attract long-stay guests, remote professionals, domestic travellers and international visitors throughout the year. The model is intended to support consistent hospitality activity in Alibaug, reducing dependence on seasonal tourism trends.

The development will also incorporate initiatives focused on local culture, regional craftsmanship and sustainable development. ***According to the company, key areas of focus include green-certified building practices, renewable energy adoption, water conservation, biodiversity preservation and responsible coastal development.*** The partnership highlights the increasing convergence of real estate, hospitality, and branded residential projects in India, particularly in emerging lifestyle destinations such as Alibaug, where infrastructure upgrades and improved connectivity are driving residential and tourism-led investments.

![Speciality Restaurants Appoints Avik Chatterjee as CEO](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-08/sxdkcdnmce.jpg)

Speciality Restaurants Limited has appointed Avik Chatterjee as Chief Executive Officer, effective Q1 FY27, marking a leadership transition at the hospitality and restaurant company. ***Chatterjee previously served as Executive Director – Innovation and New Formats, where he led the development of new restaurant concepts and business formats across the group's portfolio.***

***A second-generation entrepreneur, Chatterjee has been closely associated with the business and its flagship brand, Mainland China, founded by his father and Chairman and Managing Director, Anjanmoy Chatterjee.*** His new role expands his responsibilities to overseeing the company's operations, growth strategy, and brand portfolio across India and international markets.

As Director and CEO, Chatterjee will oversee brands including Mainland China, Oh! Calcutta, Asia Kitchen by Mainland China, Sigree, Hoppipola, Episode One, Sweet Bengal, Gong and Walters Burger, along with other restaurant formats operated by the company. ***His focus areas include strengthening existing brands, expanding into new markets, launching new dining concepts and improving operational efficiency across the business.***

Anjanmoy Chatterjee, Chairman and Managing Director, Speciality Restaurants Limited said, "***Avik has grown up within this business and has, over the years, worked across nearly every part of it, from menu and format development to operations and brand strategy. This transition reflects a natural progression rather than a departure for either of us; I remain closely involved as Chairman. Placing him in charge of day-to-day operations allows the Company to draw on both its established strengths and a clear understanding of where the industry is headed.***"

> Avik Chatterjee, Director and CEO, Speciality Restaurants Limited said, “***Speciality Restaurants has spent the last three decades building brands that customers consistently return to and my role as CEO is to strengthen that foundation rather than reinvent it. We will continue to reinforce our core brands while placing greater emphasis on newer formats, including cloud kitchens, smaller footprints, and concepts aligned with evolving consumer dining habits. Over the next three quarters, we aim to significantly expand our presence in Mumbai with 12 to 15 new Walters stores, supported by a cloud kitchen to enhance our delivery footprint. At the same time, we will focus on improving operational efficiency, leveraging technology more effectively and elevating the overall customer experience. Our approach for the coming quarters remains clear: scale what is working, empower our teams on the ground, and expand thoughtfully into the right cities with the right formats.***”

***The appointment comes as the restaurant industry continues to witness growing demand for quick service restaurants, cloud kitchens, delivery-led formats and experience-driven dining concepts.*** Under the new leadership structure, Speciality Restaurants is expected to focus on expanding its restaurant footprint while adapting to changing consumer dining preferences.

![Barista Coffee, Yoga Bar Launch Protein Coffee Range Across India](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-08/ededrfnfn.jpg)

Barista Coffee has partnered with Yoga Bar to launch a new range of protein-infused beverages and café food items across its outlets in India, targeting growing consumer interest in protein and healthier everyday eating. ***The collaboration combines Barista’s coffee offerings with Yoga Bar’s whey protein, introducing protein into familiar café beverages and food options.*** The new range is now available across Barista cafés nationwide.

***Protein Enters Café Menus***

The new range includes two beverages—Iced Caramel Whey-chino and Mocha Pro-Muscle Shake—along with a Chicken Tikka Sandwich. ***Customers can also add Yoga Bar Whey Protein to other beverages available on Barista’s menu.***

> Rajat Agrawal, CEO, Barista Coffee said, “***Protein isn't a niche thing anymore; it's just become part of how people think about food and drink every day. We are trying to build a whole new category, one that sits right at the intersection of café culture and functional nutrition.***”

The partnership aims to integrate protein into familiar café consumption occasions rather than position it only as a specialised nutrition product.

***Making Protein Part of Daily Habits***

> Anuj Bansal, CBO, Yoga Bar, ITC Limited said, “***Coffee is a daily ritual for millions of Indians, and by bringing our high-quality whey protein into their favorite café beverages, we are making it easier for coffee lovers to enjoy the nutrition they need without changing the habits they love.***”

Customers can customise their beverages with an additional serving of whey protein, allowing them to incorporate protein into their regular café visits.

***Expanding Functional Food Choices***

***The launch reflects a broader shift in food-service consumption, with consumers increasingly looking for products that combine convenience, taste and nutritional value.*** Café operators are also introducing functional ingredients into established beverage and food categories. ***Barista Coffee has operated in India for more than two decades and currently has a network of 500+ cafés across 160+ cities.*** Its menu includes coffee, beverages, and food offerings, with new products being introduced in response to changing consumer preferences.

Yoga Bar, which was recently acquired by ITC Limited, operates in the nutrition-focused food category. ***Its portfolio includes health bars, muesli, oats, protein shakes, protein powders, snacks, peanut butter, nuts and seeds, and breakfast products.*** The partnership brings protein-focused options into mainstream café consumption while retaining the convenience and familiarity of everyday coffee and food occasions.

![Ajay’s Café Records 89 Percent Surge in Cold Coffee Sales on Friendship Day](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-08/Untitled%20design%20%2845%29.jpg)

Ajay’s Café reported a sharp increase in demand for its signature burgers and cold coffees across its café network on Friendship Day, driven by higher consumer footfall and occasion-led celebrations.

**The brand said cold coffee sales jumped 89 percent compared to the previous day, reaching 16,834 cups, while burger sales increased nearly 54 percent to 33,472 units.**

The highest contribution came from Ahmedabad, Surat, and Vadodara, which together accounted for nearly 60 percent of the brand’s total Friendship Day sales across both product categories, highlighting strong demand in Gujarat’s major urban markets.

**Friendship Day emerged as a key consumption occasion, with both its flagship food and beverage offerings witnessing simultaneous growth.** Burgers and cold coffees have been central to Ajay’s menu since its inception and have increasingly become popular choices for social gatherings, casual meetups, and celebrations among consumers.

The company said its café format has evolved beyond being a place to dine, positioning itself as an accessible destination where customers can meet, spend time together, and celebrate everyday moments.

> **Jaideep Solanki, Director, Ajay's Good Food Pvt. Ltd. said,** “We have seen the cold coffee category evolve significantly in Gujarat, and Ajay’s has been a trendsetter in building and popularising the cold coffee culture, particularly across South Gujarat. What started as a signature café offering has today become a widely consumed beverage, with consumers associating cold coffee as much with everyday catch-ups and social occasions as with cafés. The Friendship Day numbers are a strong testimony to how deeply this consumption habit has taken root- selling more than 16,000 cold coffees in a single day demonstrates the scale of the occasion-led demand. For us, this is also what the ‘Happy Wali Feeling’ represents, creating familiar products and accessible café experiences that naturally become part of how people come together.”

**The Friendship Day performance marks another milestone for the café chain.** Since its inception in 2014, Ajay’s Café said it has served more than 4.36 crore burgers and 3.02 crore cold coffees, reflecting the continued popularity of its core offerings among consumers.

Rapido's Ownly Expands Restaurant Partnership Through NRAI Agreement

![Indian Retailer](https://www.indianretailer.com/themes/custom/menshealth/images/art-logo.webp)

BY - [Indian Retailer Bureau](/author/indian-retailer-bureau)  
 Sub Editor  / 1 MIN READ

[Follow Us ![Indina Retailer](https://www.indianretailer.com/themes/custom/menshealth/images/follow.webp)](https://news.google.com/publications/CAAiEJjETmBVGGR4AF2qcS42jEMqFAgKIhCYxE5gVRhkeABdqnEuNoxD?hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN%3Aen)

![Rapido's Ownly Expands Restaurant Partnership Through NRAI Agreement](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-08/frrfhfbnbc.jpg)

Rapido's standalone food delivery platform Ownly has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Restaurant Association of India (NRAI) to strengthen collaboration on transparent pricing, restaurant economics, and food delivery practices. ***The agreement was formalised during the "Serving Bengaluru Together" conference held on MG Road in Bengaluru.***

The event brought together representatives from NRAI, Ownly, and restaurant partners to discuss delivery models focused on transparent pricing, sustainable restaurant operations, and improved customer experience. ***The partnership establishes a structured collaboration between Ownly and NRAI, with the restaurant industry body supporting discussions around the platform's zero-commission model and exploring approaches that could improve value for restaurants while maintaining affordability for consumers.***

The MoU signing was witnessed by Sagar Daryani, President, National Restaurant Association of India, and CEO and Co-Founder, Wow! Momo, Aravind Sanka, Head of Ownly, and Ananth Narayan, Founder, JustBLR Group and NRAI Bengaluru Chapter Head, along with restaurant partners.

> Sagar Daryani, President, National Restaurant Association of India (NRAI), CEO and Co-Founder, Wow! Momo said, "***The restaurant industry has been seeking greater transparency and predictability in food delivery for a long time. As an industry body, our role is to work with ecosystem partners to explore models that can better address these needs and create long-term value for restaurants. This partnership with Ownly is part of that larger effort. It gives us an opportunity to understand how a zero-commission model works in practice, gather feedback from our members and continue advocating for solutions that strengthen the restaurant ecosystem while delivering a better experience for consumers.***"

Ownly also shared early operational data following its citywide expansion in Bengaluru. The platform initially launched through a pilot in Koramangala and HSR Layout in August 2025 before expanding across the city in March 2026. ***According to the company, partner restaurants have reported improved margins and higher repeat order rates after joining the platform.*** These findings were presented during discussions with NRAI members on alternative food delivery models and their impact on restaurant businesses.

> Aravind Sanka, Head, Ownly said, "***The numbers since March are telling us something we already believed: when you remove the hidden costs, both sides of the market respond. The repeat rates we are seeing are higher than anything we saw in the pilot. That is what happens when diners trust the price on the screen, and when restaurants are not engineering their menus around a commission they resent. We built Ownly to make food delivery feel fair – for the person ordering and for the kitchen that cooked it. What we are seeing in Bengaluru tells us that fairness is also good business.***"

A panel discussion at the conference focused on the operational impact of zero-commission food delivery, including restaurant margins, pricing transparency, and customer trust. ***The discussion also examined how value meal offerings could expand access to food delivery without reducing restaurant profitability.***

During the event, NRAI outlined three priorities for food delivery platforms: clearly defined written policies on fees and pricing, stable commercial structures, and collaboration with the association to share data, develop industry best practices, and support smaller restaurant operators. ***The association said it will continue to assess the outcomes of the partnership and evaluate similar models for other cities.***

> Ananth Narayan, Founder, JustBLR Group and NRAI Bengaluru Chapter Head said, "***Bengaluru has always had a vibrant restaurant community and an equally engaged consumer base that continues to shape the city’s food delivery ecosystem. This partnership with Ownly is an opportunity to further strengthen delivery models that better support restaurants while enhancing convenience and value for consumers. It reflects the industry's continued effort to work collaboratively with ecosystem partners and build solutions that contribute to the long-term sustainability of the restaurant and food delivery.***"

The conference also featured participation from restaurant partners including Empire, Vidyarthi Bhavan, and Amintiri, who shared their experiences with the Ownly platform and discussed how alternative delivery models can help restaurants build stronger customer relationships.

***Located in the Chandigarh Tricity region near the Shivalik Hills, the hotel joins IHG Hotels and Resorts' luxury lifestyle portfolio under the Vignette Collection brand.*** The opening strengthens IHG's footprint in India's premium hospitality market while expanding luxury accommodation options in North India. The hotel houses 145 guestrooms, including 11 suites, along with more than 2,200 square metres of meeting and event space. Its facilities include a luxury spa, fitness centre, swimming pool, and premium retail spaces. ***The property is positioned to serve both business and leisure travellers, while also catering to corporate events, destination weddings, conferences, and social gatherings.***

The dining portfolio at The Aarlis Hotel includes Sapio, an all-day dining restaurant, Cabinet V, a private dining venue offering contemporary Indian and European cuisine, Wakerie, an artisanal café and patisserie, and Jigger, a cocktail bar. ***The hotel will also open Sky VI, its rooftop dining destination overlooking the Shivalik Hills, in September.***

> Aman Gupta, Managing Director, SSIEL Group said, "***The opening of The Aarlis Hotel Panchkula marks a defining milestone for SSIEL Group as we diversify into the luxury hospitality sector. Our partnership with IHG to introduce South-West Asia’s and India's first Vignette Collection hotel reflects our commitment to creating world-class destinations that combine global standards with authentic Indian warmth. We believe The Aarlis will not only redefine luxury hospitality in the Chandigarh Tricity region but also contribute meaningfully to tourism, employment and the economic development of the region. We look forward to welcoming guests from India and around the world to experience a destination that celebrates exceptional hospitality, local culture and memorable experiences.***”

In addition to its hospitality facilities, The Aarlis offers nearly 30,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor event space, including the Aura Grand Ballroom, designed for conferences, weddings, exhibitions, and social events.

> Neelabh Chugh, General Manager, The Aarlis Hotel Panchkula said, "***The opening of The Aarlis Hotel Panchkula marks a defining milestone for us as we introduce South West Asia's first Vignette Collection hotel by IHG Hotels and Resorts. At The Aarlis, we have thoughtfully blended contemporary luxury with the culture and character of North India to create experiences that are authentic, memorable and deeply connected to the destination. We look forward to welcoming guests from India and around the world while establishing The Aarlis as one of the region's leading luxury hospitality destinations.***"

***The opening highlights the continued expansion of international hotel brands across India, particularly in emerging luxury hospitality markets outside metropolitan cities.*** It also reflects the growing demand for premium hotels offering integrated accommodation, dining, events, and retail experiences.

![Costa Coffee Closes 22 Stores in India in FY26 as Revenue Grows 7 Pc](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-07/ddkfnfb.jpg)

Costa Coffee's retail network in India contracted for the first time in more than five years, with the British coffee chain ending FY26 with 198 stores, compared with 220 outlets in the previous financial year. ***Despite the reduction in its café footprint, the brand recorded 7 percent year-on-year growth in revenue during the period.***

***According to the latest annual report of Devyani International Limited (DIL), Costa Coffee's exclusive franchise partner in India, the network saw a net reduction of 22 stores during FY26.*** The development comes after several years of steady expansion in India's coffee retail and café market.

Costa Coffee's revenue from operations increased to Rs 212.5 crore in FY26 from Rs 198.5 crore in FY25. The growth came despite a smaller store network, contrasting with the previous financial year when revenue rose 30.76 percent alongside a rapid increase in outlets. ***The coffee chain had expanded from 44 stores in FY21 to 55 in FY22 before more than doubling its network to 112 outlets in FY23.*** The footprint subsequently increased to 179 stores in FY24 and 220 in FY25 before declining to 198 in FY26.

Devyani International did not specify the reasons behind the reduction in Costa Coffee stores. However, the company said it followed "***a more disciplined and selective approach to expansion***" across its brand portfolio during the financial year.

The company continues to identify Costa Coffee as one of its growth drivers alongside KFC and Pizza Hut. ***The coffee chain's India strategy includes a focus on the premium out-of-home coffee segment, with younger consumers, including Gen-Z and millennials, forming an important part of its target market.***

***Costa Coffee has also been making changes to its menu as consumer preferences in India's organised café market evolve.*** The reduction in outlets during FY26 indicates a more selective approach to physical expansion after the brand added 176 stores between FY21 and FY25.

India also remains an important market in Costa Coffee's longer-term global plans. In April 2025, Costa Coffee Global CEO Philippe Schaillee identified India as one of the company's top 20 markets globally and said the country was expected to become one of its top five markets in the coming years.

The Bengaluru entry follows Kouzina's strategic investment in MOPP Foods. ***The food technology company plans to use its cloud kitchen network, technology platform and operating infrastructure to take the brand to additional cities across India.***

The move adds MOPP to Kouzina's growing portfolio of food brands as the company scales its delivery-led operations. ***Kouzina currently operates more than 20 food brands through over 350 kitchen partners across more than 125 cities.***

> Gautam Balijepalli, Co-Founder of Kouzina Food Tech said, "***Mad Over Parathas and Pakodas has already earned deep customer love in Delhi NCR through its exceptional food quality and differentiated product experience. Founded in Delhi NCR, Mad Over Parathas and Pakodas has built its menu around two widely consumed Indian food categories, parathas and pakodas. Its offerings include different varieties of parathas, pakodas, and meal combinations developed primarily for food delivery. ***The brand also uses recipes and packaging designed to maintain the food's texture and consistency during delivery, an important consideration as it expands through Kouzina's cloud kitchen infrastructure.***

The venue also offers a selection of craft beers. ***Beyond its food and beverage business, GOAT Brew plans to host live music performances, DJ nights, open mic sessions, artist showcases, workshops and community events.*** The venue also offers dedicated food and beverage options for pets.

Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters has entered the GCC market through a partnership with Ambrosia Foods, opening its first regional café at BurJuman Mall in Dubai, UAE. Blue Tokai is the fourth brand to join Ambrosia Foods' portfolio, alongside Biryani By Kilo, Furn Beaino and Mr. Brown.

> Shivam Shahi, Co-Founder and COO, Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters said, “***India has an extraordinary coffee heritage, yet its potential as a world-class specialty coffee origin is only beginning to gain global recognition. Expanding into the GCC marks an important milestone in our journey as we introduce Indian specialty coffee to new audiences. The region's vibrant café culture and appreciation for thoughtfully crafted experiences make it a natural next step in our growth.***”

The refreshed menu features a range of vegetarian dishes built around familiar ingredients with new flavour combinations. New additions include Badam Malai Broccoli, Bombay Cheese Toast, Potato Salli Chole Chaat, and Poriyal Kofta, inspired by regional Indian cuisines while offering a contemporary approach to vegetarian dining. ***PHURR has also expanded its beverage menu with new drinks such as Cane Canary, Mint Macaw, and Gongura Goose, developed to complement the restaurant's food offerings.***

Atelier Expressions, the premium lifestyle investment platform of TVS VENU, has signed an agreement to acquire a majority stake in Lonestar Hospitality Private Limited, the company behind New Delhi-based handcrafted mithai brand Khoya. ***The transaction is expected to be completed by the end of August 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Financial details of the deal have not been disclosed.***

***Founded in 2016 by Sid Mathur, Khoya offers traditional mithai, chikki, mukhwas, and savoury snacks through its online channels and select retail stores in Delhi.*** The acquisition adds the confectionery brand to Atelier Expressions' growing portfolio of lifestyle and premium consumer brands. As part of the agreement, Sid Mathur will continue to lead Khoya's operations and execution with support from the existing team.

> Tara Venu, Executive Director of Atelier Expressions said, "***Sid has reimagined one of India's oldest culinary traditions for a new generation of consumers while staying true to what makes it special. That ability to respect tradition while building a contemporary brand is exactly what attracts us to businesses like Khoya. Khoya reflects the qualities we look for at Atelier Expressions, and we look forward to working together to build on its success while preserving the authenticity and character that define the brand.***"

> Sid Mathur, Founder of Khoya said, "***This partnership with Atelier Expressions offers a tremendous opportunity to scale our presence across India, explore new collaborations, and elevate Khoya to greater success. Khoya was created from a belief that Indian mithai deserves the same care, creativity, and attention to detail as the world's finest luxury food brands. Every product we create is rooted in heritage while thoughtfully designed for the way people enjoy and share food today. As we considered the next chapter for Khoya, we wanted a partner who shares our belief in quality and long-term brand building. Atelier Expressions is a natural fit, and together we look forward to introducing more people to Indian confectionery at its very best.***"

Before founding Khoya, Mathur worked with the Impresario Group, where he contributed to the development of brands including Smoke House Deli and Social. He also established food consultancy Secret Ingredient.

***The acquisition expands Atelier Expressions' portfolio, which already includes French porcelain brand J.L. Coquet, Dubai-based restaurant Khadak, and London-based motorcycle helmet maker Hedon.*** The platform is part of TVS VENU, which operates across mobility, financial services, real estate, and lifestyle businesses in more than 90 countries.

Alcobrew Distilleries India Limited, the maker of One More Vodka, has expanded its flavoured vodka portfolio with the launch of One More Next Vodka – Twisty Minty Jamun. ***The new variant follows the introduction of the brand's Cranberry flavour and is part of the company's strategy to develop products inspired by Indian taste preferences.***

> The company said the latest addition combines the tart and earthy taste of jamun with a mint flavour. It has been developed for both neat consumption and cocktails, allowing consumers to prepare mixed drinks with minimal additional ingredients for both on-premise and at-home occasions. ***The launch is part of Alcobrew's broader flavour innovation strategy led by Romesh Pandita, Chairman and Managing Director, as the company continues to expand its flavoured vodka portfolio in line with regional consumer demand.***

> Ashutosh Rajput, Chief Operating Officer, Alcobrew Distilleries India Limited said, “***With Twisty Minty Jamun, we wanted to build a flavour around a taste Indian consumers already know. The company said the new variant is targeted at vodka consumers aged 25 to 40 years, particularly in urban and semi-urban markets, where demand for differentiated flavours and brand identity continues to grow. ***Twisty Minty Jamun retains the existing One More Next packaging design, including the bottle shape, tube packaging, logotype, and the brand's signature mascot to maintain consistency across the portfolio.***

 Sub Editor  / 1 MIN READ

[Follow Us ![Indina Retailer](https://www.indianretailer.com/themes/custom/menshealth/images/follow.webp)](https://news.google.com/publications/CAAiEJjETmBVGGR4AF2qcS42jEMqFAgKIhCYxE5gVRhkeABdqnEuNoxD?hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN%3Aen)

![Swiggy Expands ‘Food on Train’ to 180+ Cities, Orders Triple in Q1 FY27](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-07/vokka%20%284%29.jpg)

Swiggy has expanded its ‘Food on Train’ service to over 180 cities across India, reporting a threefold year-on-year growth in orders during the April–June quarter of FY27. The surge was largely driven by increased travel demand during the summer season, the company said.

The platform also witnessed a sharp rise in multi-station bookings, where passengers place food orders at more than one station during a single journey. According to Swiggy, such orders grew by over 300 per cent compared to the same period last year. Customers opting for multi-stop deliveries spent nearly 2.2 times more than those ordering at a single station. **The Bhopal–Nagpur route emerged as the most active corridor for such bookings, with more than 1,300 passengers placing orders at both stations during the same trip.**

To streamline the ordering process, Swiggy introduced a “Scan Your Ticket” feature. This allows users to upload their train tickets, automatically detect the PNR number, and place orders without manually entering travel details.

**The company has also expanded its network by adding 17 new railway stations, including Gurugram, Udaipur, Bikaner, Davanagere, Kayamkulam, Nanded, Amravati, Shoranur, Arrah, Tadpatri and Nizamabad.**Swiggy noted that adoption is increasing in smaller towns, with 66 per cent of orders in Guna, Madhya Pradesh, coming from first-time users.

> “Food on Train has witnessed exponential growth in the last one year and the last quarter has been no different, with a threefold year-on-year growth in orders. It is heartening to see the consumer response across the country, with customers increasingly booking meals well in advance. Even in Tier IV towns, travellers are discovering digital food ordering for the first time while waiting at railway stations,” said Deepak Maloo, Vice President-Food Strategy, Customer Experience and New Initiatives at Swiggy.

In terms of food preferences, roti emerged as the most ordered item during the summer, with over four lakh orders. Other popular choices included masala dosa, aloo paratha, McAloo Tikki Burger and chicken biryani, which was the top non-vegetarian dish.

Beverage demand also rose significantly amid rising temperatures. Mango shake recorded the highest seasonal growth, with orders increasing nearly tenfold compared to winter. Soft drink orders grew by 354 per cent, while lassi orders doubled and ice cream orders rose by 140 per cent.

Swiggy said its Food on Train service is contributing to digital adoption beyond metro cities, with emerging towns reporting 253 per cent year-on-year growth, outpacing larger urban centres.

![Amrut Launches Coffee-Cask Whisky CaféX in Limited Global Release](https://indian-retailer.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2026-07/Amrut%20Distilleries%20launches%20Caf%C3%A9X%2C%20India%E2%80%99s%20first%20coffee-cask%20single%20malt%20whisky%2C%20matured%20in%20coffee-seasoned%20casks%20from%20Harley%20Estate.%20Limited%20to%202%2C400%20bottles%20globally%2C%20it%20blends%20Karnataka%E2%80%99s%20whisk%20%281%29.jpg)

Amrut Distilleries has launched a new Indian single malt whisky called CaféX, marking it as India’s first coffee-cask expression. The Bengaluru-based company said the product brings together whisky-making and coffee cultivation traditions from Karnataka.

CaféX has been matured in casks seasoned with coffee beans sourced from the Harley Estate in Sakaleshpur, a plantation established in 1864. The release highlights an experimental approach to whisky maturation, which has traditionally relied on oak, wine, or sherry casks.

> Rakshit N Jagdale, Managing Director of Amrut Distilleries, said, “CaféX is a celebration of two things India does exceptionally well—crafting world-class single malt and growing exceptional coffee. Bringing them together through an innovative approach to cask maturation reflects our enduring commitment to pushing the boundaries of whisky making while remaining deeply rooted in our heritage.”

The whisky has been developed in collaboration with the Harley Estate, known for its specialty coffee. According to Purnesh, owner of the estate, the partnership allowed both sides to experiment with flavour development. “Partnering with Amrut gave us access to their award-winning whisky barrels… ageing our estate-grown specialty coffee in them bridges two worlds of Indian craft, creating a bold, complex cup unlike anything we’ve processed before,” he said.

Amrut said only 2,400 bottles of CaféX will be available globally, positioning it as a limited-edition release. The company has previously introduced experimental variants such as Naarangi, Spectrum and Herald as part of its portfolio.

> Ashok Chokalingam, Chief Operating Officer and Master Distiller at Amrut, highlighted, “To encounter a distinct jalapeño and capsicum profile within a single malt is an extreme rarity… this is a ‘unicorn’ expression, destined for the most discerning collections.”

According to the tasting notes shared by the company, CaféX features a golden honey appearance and combines savoury notes of capsicum and jalapeño with layers of mocha, vanilla and citrus. The palate is described as a mix of floral and fruity tones balanced with spice, followed by a long, sweet and slightly spicy finish.

Founded in 1948, Amrut Distilleries is part of the NR Jagdale Group and is one of Karnataka’s established liquor manufacturers. The company has gained global recognition over the years for its single malt offerings and experimental releases.

Vegetarian pan-Asian restaurant chain Burma Burma reported strong top-line growth in FY26, with revenue from operations increasing 47 percent year-on-year to Rs 155.6 crore from Rs 106 crore in FY25. **Despite the revenue growth, the company reported a wider net loss as operating expenses increased at a faster pace.**

**The restaurant chain, which serves Burmese cuisine with Indian, Chinese, and Thai influences, currently operates more than a dozen outlets across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Chandigarh.**

**Bengaluru continued to be Burma Burma's largest market during the financial year, contributing nearly Rs 50 crore, or more than 32 percent of its total revenue.** Mumbai generated Rs 38.4 crore, while Delhi and Gurugram contributed around Rs 15 crore each. **The balance of the revenue came from Hyderabad, Noida, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Chandigarh.**

**Dine-in business remained the company's primary source of income, accounting for Rs 128 crore, or approximately 82 percent of operating revenue.** Online orders through food delivery platforms contributed Rs 15.9 crore during the year.

**Although Burma Burma reported robust revenue growth, the rapid rise in expenses, particularly depreciation and amortisation, impacted profitability.** The company's net loss widened nearly six times to Rs 14.5 crore in FY26 from Rs 2.5 crore in the previous fiscal year.

**At the operating level, EBITDA increased 35 percent year-on-year to Rs 29 crore.** The company reported an EBITDA margin of 18.65 percent, while its return on capital employed (ROCE) stood at negative 10.1 percent. During the financial year, Burma Burma spent Rs 1.13 to generate every rupee of operating revenue.

**As of March 2026, the company reported cash and bank balances of Rs 18 crore, while its total current assets stood at Rs 24.6 crore.**

**Burma Burma has raised a total of $11 million in funding to date.** In March this year, the company secured a $4 million (Rs 38 crore) funding round that valued the business at Rs 500 crore.

results.raw_content:
The 8-year-old YouTuber Ryan Kaji has transformed the future of kids entertainment by becoming a new model of cross-platform child star.

Kaji now earns millions each year from his lucrative business empire across YouTube, TV, and the shelves of major retailers like Target and Walmart.

But his rise to fame started on YouTube in 2015, with videos of him unboxing toys.

"Viewership doubled and tripled each month after that point," Ryan's father, Shion, told Business Insider. "More than just in the US, we see that growth globally. At first, I was very confused and surprised to see our homemade-quality videos being watched by so many kids around the world."

With the help of his business-savvy parents and Pocket.Watch, a studio that represents the family, Kaji has expanded beyond YouTube by starring in shows on Nickelodeon and Roku, and selling branded products in stores.

In 2019, Ryan's family renamed the YouTube channel to "Ryan's World," a franchise they started that has continued to grow, earning more than $20 million a year in advertising revenue from YouTube, and generating more than $200 million in retail sales from branded products that year, according to a family spokesperson.

Business Insider spoke with Ryan's father, Shion, and mother, Loann, about their business and how they manage Ryan's personal life and YouTube fame.

Ryan's channel started with videos of him opening and reviewing toys. In July 2015, one of his early "unboxing videos" went viral. The video, which now has more than 1 billion views, featured Ryan opening and reviewing a box containing more than 100 toys from Pixar's "Cars" series.

Shortly after, Ryan grew a name for himself online as the boy on YouTube who reviews toys, and throughout the years his videos have shifted from toys to challenges and educational videos, like DIY science experiments.

"I feel like Ryan's relationship with his fans is very unique and different from talent on TV," Shion said. "His relationship with his fans is more of a friendship where every time we meet Ryan's fans and their family, they always mention, 'Oh, my son or daughter thinks they are Ryan's best friend.'"

In 2017, the family signed with the full-service entertainment studio for internet creators, Pocket.Watch. The company acts as an agent for Ryan's brand, Ryan's World, and has invested in building an empire around the YouTube star.

But as Ryan's fame grew, his parents recognized the need to create a larger team around him and make the filming process more efficient for Ryan.

"So he can still enjoy the life of a normal kid," Shion said.

Now the family manages a 30-person production company, Sunlight Entertainment, in their home state of Texas.

"What we thought is best for him, would be starting out a production company to help streamline the workflow on the channel and also minimize Ryan's participation in the videos," Shion said. "The main thing is Ryan's privacy and his childhood. And we also wanted to prioritize Ryan's education over anything else."

When Ryan is attending school during the day, Shion and Loann will usually head to their office and work with their team of editors, animators, and voice actors to produce content. The team works on developing live-action and animated content across the company's nine multilingual YouTube channels: Ryan's World, Ryan's World Español, Ryan's World in Japanese, EK Doodles, Ryan's Family Review, VTubers, Combo Panda, Gus the Gummy Gator and The Studio Space. (Since the coronavirus outbreak the family has been working from home, they said.)

"When we started our own company, the first thing we did was make sure Ryan was always the central part of the brand," Shion said. "We tried to create a universe around Ryan but within that universe there are animated characters that are friends of Ryan and their personalities are based on Ryan's basic attributes. When [fans] watch the content through those characters they still feel the connection they have with Ryan."

There is a universe of products around Ryan, as well.

Pocket.Watch brought the Ryan's World brand to Colgate, Nickelodeon, Roku, and Walmart. Pocket.Watch has developed over 100 licensees, from launching an entire line of Ryan's World consumer products with toy-manufacturing company Bonkers, to creating and producing "Ryan's Mystery Playdate," which airs on Nickelodeon. The company recently launched an ad-supported channel called "Ryan and Friends," available to stream on The Roku Channel.

Typically, Shion said they will film content with Ryan for about one hour during the weekday (some weeks Ryan doesn't film at all during the week), and about three hours on the weekend.

"With traditional media, kids are on set all day," Loann said. "What we are trying to do is give him a normal childhood. He has plenty of time to do and explore other interests."

"We felt like that really helped us not burn out – not just Ryan but Loann and myself too were able to balance out our personal lives and work," Shion added.

Before stay-at-home orders, Ryan was involved in several after-school activities – like swimming, computer coding, and taekwondo – Loann said.

"Whatever Ryan wants to film we always make sure we can accomplish it," Shion said. "The second thing is, Loann used to teach high school chemistry and her passion has always been teaching children. After some time, we felt like that was a very important component on YouTube: education. Over time, we've changed our brand focusing more and more on educational content."

Shion also said the family's goal is to expand their reach into new places like Japan (Ryan is half Japanese), as well as Spanish-speaking countries.

"We want to make sure Ryan understands and learns the history of his background too," Shion said. "So, we are trying to get more and more projects in Japan as well."

8-year-old Ryan Kaji of YouTube's Ryan's World (formerly Ryan ToysReview) is the highest-paid YouTube star in the world, and has built a business empire from reviewing toys — with help from his parents.

Kaji earned an estimated $26 million, according to Forbes, based on pretax figures from June 2018 to June 2019. That's a jump from the $22 million Kaji earned the previous year. The second biggest earner this year was the group Dude Perfect with $20 million.

Since Kaji started hosting the ToysReview unboxing videos in 2015, it's grown into a mega-popular brand called Ryan's World, and its YouTube channel has 23 million subscribers. The channel started out slowly until a July 2015 video went viral. The video featured Ryan opening and reviewing a box containing more than 100 toys from Pixar's "Cars" series. It now has more than 1 billion views.

As the channel began to grow in views and subscribers, Michael Bienstock, chief executive of the influencer-focused wealth-management company Semaphore, reached out and had a conversation with Ryan's dad about how complicated things would get financially if the channel continued to grow at this pace, Bienstock told Business Insider in a previous interview.

Ryan's business empire is certainly more complicated now, having grown from toothbrushes to a television show with the help of kids-entertainment company Pocket.Watch.

The company brought the Ryan's World brand to Colgate, Nickelodeon, Bonkers Toys, Roku, and Walmart, expanding Ryan from YouTube. Now, Ryan's World merchandise can be found at Target, Walmart, and Amazon. His line has more than 100 toys in it, according to Forbes. On the traditional media front, he has deals with Nickelodeon and Hulu.

John Lynch contributed reporting.
